## Synthesis

BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning is a child and adolescent psychiatric ("børne- og ungdomspsykiatrisk") clinic located in Region Midtjylland, Denmark [^src1] [^src2] [^src4] [^src12]. It is one of the regional units tracked by the ADHD-databasen, a Danish national quality database that monitors ADHD diagnostic and treatment pathways across the country's five regions [^src1]. The clinic appears repeatedly in the ADHD-databasen's annual reports covering the periods 01.04.2023–31.03.2024 and 01.04.2024–31.03.2025, which assess how well regional psychiatric units meet the database's quality indicators — standards set at a 90% target for most measures [^src1] [^src6].

In the 2023 report, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning stands out for its comparatively poor performance on several indicators. Among 433 total assessment ("udredning") courses, the clinic achieved only 17% fulfillment of Indicator 3, which measures diagnostic conferences held within 120 days of assessment start (95% confidence interval: 13–21%) [^src1]. On Indicator 2b — covering manualized diagnostic interviews or environmental observation — the clinic reached 22% fulfillment across the same 433 assessment courses [^src1]. A separate table in the report also lists a 17% figure (95% CI: 0–64%) attributed to Indicator 4, concerning coordinating network meetings held within 90 days of treatment start [^src2]. On somatic assessment, the clinic reported only 58 of 433 courses (13%, 95% CI: 10–17%) including the required somatic work-up, a rate described in the source report as "very low" [^src12].

Other tables from the same reporting period show sparser or null results for the clinic: one page records "0/6" with 0% fulfillment (95% CI: 0–46%) [^src3], and an appendix table on discontinued ("afkræftede") assessment courses lists figures of "3 3 6" for the clinic [^src5]. The clinic is also named, without additional detail, in a section discussing barriers to indicator fulfillment across regions [^src4].

The 2024 report (covering 01.04.2024–31.03.2025) shows some improvement in reported figures for BUA — Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning (the name appears with an en-dash in this later document). The clinic recorded 40 of 93 assessment courses (43%, 95% CI: 33–54%) on one indicator [^src6] and 55 of 93 (59%, 95% CI: 48–69%) on another [^src7]. Elsewhere in the same report, figures are redacted or shown as "#/#" with 0% fulfillment (95% CI: 0–98%) [^src8] [^src9] [^src10], and a later appendix table lists the number "12" against the clinic's name [^src11]. This later report frames Region Midtjylland generally as showing "positive udvikling" (positive development) relative to other regions, even as national fulfillment of the key indicators (51% for Indicator 2b and 27% for Indicator 3) remained far below the 90% development target [^src6].

Across both reporting periods, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning is consistently identified as part of, and located within, Region Midtjylland [^src1] [^src2] [^src4] [^src12] — one of Denmark's five regions whose child and adolescent psychiatric departments are compared throughout the ADHD-databasen's annual reporting on ADHD diagnostic quality.
